description: This file defines the main API router for a personal finance tracking backend using FastAPI. It includes endpoints for managing categories, transactions, budgets, dashboard summaries, and stub endpoints for audits and notifications.

methods.name: create_category(cat: schemas.CategoryCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: models.User = Depends(auth.get_current_user))
methods.description: Creates a new category for the current user.

methods.name: list_categories(db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: models.User = Depends(auth.get_current_user))
methods.description: Lists all categories for the current user.

methods.name: delete_category(cat_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: models.User = Depends(auth.get_current_user))
methods.description: Deletes a specified category for the current user.

methods.name: add_transaction(tran: schemas.TransactionCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: models.User = Depends(auth.get_current_user))
methods.description: Adds a new transaction for the current user.

methods.name: list_transactions(skip: int = 0, limit: int = 100, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: models.User = Depends(auth.get_current_user))
methods.description: Retrieves a list of transactions for the current user, supports pagination.

methods.name: get_transaction(tran_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: models.User = Depends(auth.get_current_user))
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific transaction.

methods.name: update_transaction(tran_id: int, tran: schemas.TransactionCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: models.User = Depends(auth.get_current_user))
delete_transaction(tran_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: models.User = Depends(auth.get_current_user))
upload_receipt(tran_id: int, file: UploadFile = File(...), db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: models.User = Depends(auth.get_current_user))
methods.description: Uploads a receipt file for a specific transaction.

methods.name: create_budget(budget: schemas.BudgetCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: models.User = Depends(auth.get_current_user))
methods.description: Creates a new budget for the current user.

methods.name: list_budgets(db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: models.User = Depends(auth.get_current_user))
methods.description: Lists all budgets for the current user.

methods.name: delete_budget(budget_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: models.User = Depends(auth.get_current_user))
dashboard(db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: models.User = Depends(auth.get_current_user))
methods.description: Provides a summary dashboard including balance, expenses, income, budgets progress, and recent transactions.

methods.name: list_audits(db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: models.User = Depends(auth.get_current_user))
methods.description: Lists audit logs for the current user.
